account.title: Account
account.heading: My Account
account.subtitle: Manage your personal information and security settings.
account.mandatoryText: You must change your temporary password before you can browse the app.
account.personalInfoDesc: These details will be used to secure your account in the future.
account.profileLocked: You can edit these details once your new password is set.
account.displayDesc: Adjust grid density, navigation and the space shown at startup. Settings you leave unchanged follow the instance defaults.
account.securityDesc: Update your password to keep your account safe.

account.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least {min} characters long.
account.passwordTooLong: Password is too long: at most {max} bytes (fewer characters if you use accents or emoji).
account.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed successfully.
account.tokensDesc: Generate a token to connect an external app (mobile client, script) to your account.
account.tokenNeverAgain: ⚠️ This token will never be shown again.
account.scopeHint: A read-only token can only read (GET requests); full access can also change things on your behalf.
account.revokeMessage: Revoke this token? Any app using it will immediately lose access.
account.expiresIn: Expires in {count} day | Expires in {count} days
